QA_revision_reason: Independent code review requested negative equivalence boundary, context range rescaling, and exact-binomial nominal-error regression gates; N and inference method unchanged. Prior synthetic validation retained separately.
purpose: Prospective fixed-sample method validation; no Polar Dynamics model execution
synthetic_sampling: Exact multinomial sufficient-statistic sampling from explicit finite-support laws; not approximation by a normal distribution
coverage_metric: Probability all nine interval estimates contain their true means
type_I_metric: At practical superiority null boundary, probability of any false improved declaration
equivalence_error_metric: At either equivalence boundary, probability of any false equivalent declaration
power_metric: Correct scalar improved/worsened/equivalent classification, subject to fixed precision requirement
precision_metric: Fraction whose unclipped empirical-Bernstein half-width is no larger than 1/256
Monte_Carlo_uncertainty: Two-sided exact binomial 95% intervals for each reported rate; these intervals describe simulation precision, not theorem validation
acceptance: Analytical FWER proof required independently. For each cell and each of4 family error rates (miscoverage/false-improved/false-worsened/false-equivalent), test the Monte Carlo binomial error rate against0.05 using an exact upper-tail test; reject implementation if p<0.01/(4*number_of_cells). This controls QA false alarms jointly; it does not certify every possible distribution.
